base_url.correction: Modal has no single documented public endpoint base URL. Deployed Web Functions use https://<source>--<label>.modal.run or a configured custom domain.

rate_limits.correction: For a new account, the workspace limit is 200 Function calls or HTTP requests per second with a 5-second burst multiplier; excess requests return HTTP 429.

cors.correction: Web Functions created with @modal.fastapi_endpoint automatically have CORS enabled.

notes: Modal's official status page reported all services online on August 11, 2026. The entry fails because api.modal.com is not the documented base for deployed public endpoints, a current default rate limit is published, and CORS is documented as automatically enabled for fastapi_endpoint Web Functions. The current decorator name is @modal.fastapi_endpoint; @modal.web_endpoint is deprecated.
